note: Features that worked before the restricted-wasm-v1 move and are off now. Decision 2026-11-22: no Bunsho release while this list is not empty (scripts/deploy-gate.mjs). Remove an entry only when the feature works again.

features.label: 文書を開き、編集し、端末に保存する（版の比較つきの保存、別のタブの変更の検出、未保存の入力の保護）
features.reason: The sandboxed guest has no IndexedDB, localStorage or sessionStorage; Bunsho does not open a document it cannot keep.
features.waits-for: KOTOBA-968 (host-mediated storage with compare-and-swap and change notification)

features.label: バックアップと回復用のデータを書き出す（.bs1/.bs2/.bs3、未保存の入力、旧データ）
features.reason: The sandbox has no way to hand a file to the user.
